what: Nova makes metrology equipment for chipmaking: systems that measure the thickness, shape and composition of layers on a wafer during manufacturing, so defects are caught before the wafer is finished.
customers: Semiconductor manufacturers and foundries, who fit the systems into their production lines.
money: maintenance and spares on installed systems
moat: Measurement recipes tuned to a specific manufacturing process, which take months to develop and which the customer will not redo for a competitor's tool.
risks: 35 times earnings and 9.6 times sales: priced for continued growth
Revenue depends on semiconductor capital spending, which moves in sharp cycles
Revenue fell from $571M to $518M in the 2023 downturn, so it is not immune
opportunities: A 29.4% net margin, among the best in semiconductor equipment, with $536M of cash against $68M of debt
Revenue grew from $416M to $881M in four years
Advanced chip packaging for AI accelerators needs more metrology steps per wafer, which is new demand
watch: Bookings from leading-edge foundries and advanced packaging customers.
